title: Vampire Vape Pinkman Cherry 10ml Nic salt E-Liquid
description: Vampire Vape Pinkman Cherry Nic Salt E-Liquid adds a rich, stone-fruit twist to the legendary Pinkman profile. This blend starts with the iconic Pinkman base of sweet Red Berries (featuring prominent Strawberry and Raspberry notes with subtle zesty Citrus hints) and infuses it with the deep, bold taste of ripe Cherry. The addition of Cherry provides a darker, sweeter depth that contrasts with the zesty Tropical hints of the original mix. It creates a well-rounded and intense fruit profile that is satisfying without being overly sharp, offering a sophisticated alternative to the original recipe. Formulated as a Nicotine Salt, this 10ml e-liquid delivers a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine satisfaction, mirroring the sensation of smoking more closely than standard freebase nicotine. With a balanced 50VG/50PG ratio, it is perfectly optimised for use in low-powered starter kits and pod vape devices.
